title: Clean design, great for building streaks
body: Really nice clean design. Allows you to see weekly, monthly and annual views of your habit streaks. I tried a bunch of other trackers and found that this one was the best on trying to build and track new habit streaks. It has a great widget function as well.
author: Noir=+

title: Love it!
body: I’ve discovered this app at the end of December, which is perfect because I can use it to start new healthier habits in the new year! It’s easy to use and didn’t cost too much. I took advantage of a 50% reduction offer, so I paid £9.99 for a whole year - bargain!
author: EmmaB491

title: Beautiful app
body:
I’ve tried a lot of habit trackers and I think I’ll be sticking to this one. I love that it shows months/years so you can see your consistency over time. The widgets are pretty too. 

Just some very small things which would really be the cherry on the cake: 

I would really like to have the option to display a count number rather than streaks, as I find that more motivating. And the option to not have to set a goal for the number of times to do a habit. Maybe make the font/ui of each individual habit tile bigger? I only have 3 habits so the today page can look a bit empty. The weekly streak boxes could be made bigger, so you can feel proud when looking at it!

title: Great app
body: I love this app. I like to set challenges for myself  and this keeps me on course as I hate to break a trend. Having started with the two free grids I have today purchased the reasonably priced annual subscription so that I can add to those (I now have four and am wondering what others to add!) The reminders keep me on track and the format/layout is pleasing and easy to use. Would recommend.
